shellCommands.command: git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5 && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -200

cat package.json && echo ---- && cat index.html && echo ---- && cat src/App.tsx && echo ---- && cat src/main.tsx && echo ---- && cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore && echo ---- && head -60 __agent_eval__/run.mjs

ls -la && ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head -5; node -v; npm -v; grep -o '"node_modules/[^"]*markdown[^"]*"' package-lock.json | head; grep -n '"node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit"' -A3 package-lock.json | head; timeout 20 npm view marked version 2>&1 | tail -2

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && ls node_modules | grep -i -E "markdown|remark|marked" ; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep -E '"(version|main|types)"'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -name "TextArea*.d.ts" | head;

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextArea/TextArea.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextArea/TextAreaControl.d.ts | head -40; grep -rn "TextArea\|Card\|Text\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -80
timeout 300 npm install react-markdown@9 remark-gfm@4 2>&1 | tail -5 && grep -E '"(react-markdown|remark-gfm)"' package.json

cd node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && for v in --g-color-line-generic --g-color-base-background --g-color-base-neutral-light --g-color-text-secondary --g-color-text-link --g-font-family-monospace --g-border-radius-m --g-color-base-generic; do printf "%s: " $v; grep -rl -- "$v:" --include=*.css . | head -1; echo; done; sed -n 1,40p components/Text/Text.d.ts 2>/dev/null || ls components/Text

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build && for v in --g-color-line-generic --g-color-base-background --g-color-base-neutral-light --g-color-text-secondary --g-color-text-link --g-font-family-monospace --g-border-radius-m; do printf "%s: " $v; grep -rl -e "$v:" . 2>/dev/null | head -1; echo; done

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -rho -- "--g-color-line-generic[^:;]*" . 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c | head -5; grep -rho -- "--g-color-base-background[^:;]*" . 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c | head -3; grep -rho -- "--g-font-family-monospace[^:;]*" . 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -3; grep -rho -- "--g-border-radius-m[^:;]*" . 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -3; grep -rho -- "--g-color-text-link[^:;]*" . 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -3; grep -rho -- "--g-color-base-neutral-light[^:;]*" . 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -3;  grep -rho -- "--g-color-text-secondary[^:;]*" . 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -3
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && timeout 300 npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30
timeout 300 npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -30

which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && ls node_modules | grep -i -E "^playwright|^puppeteer|jsdom|happy-dom" ; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -i -E "vitest|playwright"
